arithmeticOrder: Magic Attack Up: signed16 XA *4 /3, stored
Magic Defense Up: signed16 XA *2 /3, stored
Chicken or Frog: signed16 XA *3 /2 once, stored
Zodiac compatibility, including its unsigned16 XA*25 temporary and neutral floor/Serpentarius exception
clarifications: The percentage labels denote exact rational arithmetic, not multipliers1.33 or0.67.
Magic Defense Up and Shell stack as separate stores, not one OR-qualified reduction.
Chicken and Frog share one bonus; both statuses together do not apply it twice.
This wrapper modifies work XA, not the caster current MA or final HP field; strengthening precedes it and XA*Y/Faith follow it in formula0x08.
The wrapper has no branch or RNG call; broader caller/formula support is not implied by verifying these addresses.

boundaries: The routine changes work XA only, not unit MA, Y, HP or RNG.
No support bit leaves XA unchanged; the branch delay slot only loads a register constant.
This is a leaf routine with no jal; the wiki return-address warning is MIPS calling-convention guidance, not a C# restriction.
Exhaustive arithmetic comparison is an offline integer check, not original/C execution or admission of every signed16 value into a managed battle.

clarifications: A set support bit applies the reduction; beq skips it when the bit is clear.
The sign-correction register can be negative for negative XA; the wiki should-be-zero annotation is not a valid assumption across the signed16 domain.
The effect is exactly two thirds, not a decimal66% multiplier or nearest/floor rounding.
The leaf routine changes work XA only, with no RNG or unit-stat write. The no-r31-save warning concerns adding MIPS calls, not managed callers.
The exhaustive comparison is offline integer arithmetic, not original/C execution or a wider battle admission domain.

suppliedMagicalTargetXaCheck.managedMapping: FaithMagicAmountFormula.PrepareProduct applies Shell then TargetChickenOrFrog as separate ScaleXa stores; FaithMagicInputs combines t.Chicken || t.Frog.
clarifications: Shell stores before the optional Frog/Chicken reload; their combined effect is not an identity on all inputs.
The signed /2 correction truncates toward zero, not general upward rounding; negative arithmetic sra sign values are not always0 or1.
A zero-valued beq skips the respective effect. Neither bit set preserves work XA.
No unit-stat/status change, RNG draw or subroutine call occurs; MIPS leaf-call warnings are not managed API requirements.
Full signed-domain comparison is offline arithmetic evidence and does not expand managed battle/status admission.
